question: Which of the 63 paired Table 6 intervals have annotated motif coordinates, mm10 reference CpGs and observed native methylation in the original study specimens?
decision: Qualify exact binding rows, motif/flank geometry and available common-CpG comparisons before any association, separately for tissue and organoids.
strongest_rival: Selection of 63 sites, tissue and culture composition, shared technical runs, missing or ambiguous samples, variable depth and lack of independent state labels can restrict an eventual comparison.
discriminator: Actual reference sequence and unzoomed specimen-specific bigWig intervals distinguish structural CpG absence, unreported values and represented zero fractions.
exposure_record: Original paper, Table 6 binding interpretation, S0-S6 and deposit review were known. Stage 1 examines presence, units, depth and missingness. No association or between-arm effect was inspected or estimated.
biological_unit: Native ATAC and tissue methylation use mice, separate organoid methylation uses source-labelled mouse lines. Binding uses paired sequences with one library per protein condition. Reads, CpGs, loci, barcodes and technical pools are nested observations.
nesting_and_overlap: Deduplicate shared specimen/donor accessions across technical records. Do not pool tissue and organoid cohorts. Full and extended ATAC exports are distinct technical sources, with original within-cohort controls preferred.
population_and_selection: All 63 original amplicons, both raw protein conditions and original motif classes; six P4 organoid and twelve whole-colon tracks. All eligible and unavailable sample-window cells retained.
contrast: Coverage only. Count shared reference CpGs within each proposed organoid history, tissue vehicle history, recovered drug, and four-arm tissue set. No methylation differences or binding contrasts calculated.
endpoint: Original Excel rows, pinned intervals and components, source hashes, each reference CpG measurement status, specimen/window coverage and exact shared positions for the proposed contrasts.
methods: Use zero-based half-open geometry from Regions.csv and floored score center/relative offsets from author v1.0.1 notebook. Both bases of every counted dyad lie inside its window. Include amplicon, score, composite, annotated AP1 and FOX subcores and nonoverlapping left/right flanks outside the score/composite union. Validate reference assembly, source interval bounds, fraction range, duplicate bases, and an independent repeated S3 regional download in every track. Reference plus-C site with no stored entry is missing; a stored zero is represented zero. Summarize coverage without magnitudes or history contrasts.
missingness_and_exclusions: No FOX/composite annotation in AP1-only group means inapplicable. No reference CpGs, missing plus-C observations, measured zero and positive covered status are preserved. A locus qualifies for a methylation contrast only with at least one common site present in each intended mouse/line; report all failures. BigWigs lack sequencing-depth denominators.
multiplicity: No tests, effect estimates, outcome selection or rankings. Retain all 63 intervals and all original samples including unavailable cases.
precision_basis: Technical coverage and presence only. No biological precision or power estimated.
interpretation_limit: Source qualification does not identify cellular state, occupancy, retained protein, methylation causality, biochemical interaction strength or change after exposure.
stop_rule: Stop on unmatched original score/amplicon keys, malformed reference, changed audit slice or overlapping contradictory intervals. End Stage 1 at availability, no association.
amendment_reason: Owner-requested source and coverage qualification after S6. Separate Stage 1 metadata receipt.
